slices.focus: Family financial demands deplete bonus and force household budget reset.
slices.summary: Two family expenses hit at once (sister's academy term fees, parents' seafood stall shortfall), forcing Jae-hyun to use his entire bonus for support. He and Min-seo redo the budget together, agreeing on a money threshold rule, a capped family-help category, and a slow rebuild plan rather than trying to replace the bonus immediately.
decisions: His cash flow tightened again after another round of family support, delaying his savings plans despite earning about 56
